title: A clarification on the distinction between nonlocal error and profile residual error in a computer-assisted proof of 3D Euler singularity
summary: In \cite{zhang2025dimension}, the author discusses the applicability of a nonexistence result for self-similar profiles to the Hou--Luo scenario and raises questions about the approximate self-similar profile constructed in \cite{ChenHou2023a,ChenHou2023b}. In this note, we clarify two main points. First, the far-field discrepancy identified in \cite{zhang2025dimension} is the raw nonlocal Poisson error, not the profile residual error used in the stability proof of \cite{ChenHou2023a,ChenHou2023b}.
